about: Fixed host (Gront) banner lines on the screens after chat. Shown by the web app, signed for the voice by the API (copy in api/takomo_api/data, synced by python -m takomo_api.export_schema). Each line is a list of paragraphs; the voice reads them joined by a space.

swing_intro: One normal swing. Let’s see what your clubs are working with.
swing_reading: Reading your swing right here on your device. Nothing gets uploaded.
swing_tempo: Got your timing. Tempo helps pick the shaft profile; your answers guide the rest.
swing_no_tempo: No timing this time. That’s fine: we’ll lean on your answers.
enrichment_intro: No extra numbers? No problem. This whole step is optional.
Got a few to share? They give me more context for your fitting—less guesswork, not a promise of perfect answers. Skip anything you don’t know.
